cues: Cytokinins promote cell division, cytokinesis, which gives them their name, though only when auxin is also present.
The first, kinetin, was found by Miller and Skoog in autoclaved herring sperm DNA.

text: Cytokinins promote cell division, cytokinesis, which gives them their name, though only when auxin is also present. The first, kinetin, was found by Miller and Skoog in autoclaved herring sperm DNA. The first natural one, zeatin, came from maize grains. Cytokinins are made mainly in root tips and travel up in the xylem.
